source: D&D 5e Player's Handbook (2014) Paladin and Ranger spell lists
notes: Every key is the SRD 5e spell 'index' and was verified against src/data/srd/5e-SRD-Spells.json.

Values: 'any' = any of the nine alignments may take the spell; an array = alignments the spell is restricted to. Group tokens ('good', 'evil', 'lawful', 'neutral') are followed by the explicit per-alignment entries so consumers never have to expand groups.

Paladin rule source: PHB p.85 'Divine Magic' / p.187 'Spellcasting' - a paladin's prepared spells must be of the paladin's alignment. Ranger rule source: PHB p.192 'Spellcasting' - same requirement for rangers.

Restricted paladin spells are the alignment-coded cleric-derived ones: detect-evil-and-good, protection-from-evil-and-good and dispel-evil-and-good are good-aligned (they sense, ward and expel evil creatures). No paladin spell in the PHB is restricted to evil or to lawful/neutral.

spirit-guardians is 'any': its PHB text explicitly branches on the caster's alignment (angelic/fey apparitions and radiant damage for good or neutral, fiendish apparitions and necrotic damage for evil).

Spells with alignment-neutral text that merely excludes or alters particular creature TYPES stay 'any': command and cure-wounds (no effect on undead/constructs), find-steed (celestial, fey or fiend steed), magic-circle (celestial/elemental/fey/fiend/undead, with an inverting option), raise-dead (cannot return an undead creature to life), geas and zone-of-truth.
The whole PHB 2014 Ranger list is 'any' - no ranger spell is tied to an alignment, so the ranger table has no restricted entries.

Dropped - on the PHB 2014 Paladin list but absent from 5e-SRD-Spells.json: searing-smite (1st), thunderous-smite (1st), wrathful-smite (1st), aura-of-vitality (3rd), blinding-smite (3rd), spirit-shelter (3rd), aura-of-faith (4th), aura-of-life (4th), aura-of-purity (4th), staggering-smite (4th), destructive-wave (5th).
Dropped - on the PHB 2014 Ranger list but absent from 5e-SRD-Spells.json: snare (1st), guardian-of-nature (4th), conjure-volley (5th).

Included although 5e-SRD-Spells.json does not tag them with the paladin class (their class field omits them): animate-objects, commune, greater-restoration, freedom-of-movement, spirit-guardians - all five are on the PHB 2014 Paladin list (freedom-of-movement at Paladin 4, the 5th-level spells at Paladin 9) and exist in the SRD spell file.
Counts: Paladin list has 47 spells in the PHB 2014 - 36 present here and 11 dropped above. Ranger list has 40 spells in the PHB 2014 - 37 present here and 3 dropped above.
